articles.titleCn: 任意多边形振荡器：将多边形合成推广到任意形状、变形和三维多面体
articles.abstractCn: 多边形合成通过相位器遍历多边形周长来生成音频；现有研究采用恒定角速度，而所提出的系统采用恒定弧长（周长）速度。现有公式基于规则、参数化定义的多边形，在单一形状家族内产生平滑的音色过渡。本文在统一弧长引擎的基础上推广了多边形合成：任何来源的顶点数据都输入相同的数字信号处理流水线。首先，我们使振荡器能够接受来自外部缓冲区的任意顶点配置，为各种闭合多边形——规则的、不规则的或星形的——作为波形发生器提供了可能性。其次，混合插值算法实现了具有不同顶点数的多边形之间的平滑变形，通过没有参数化描述的中间形状。第三，我们将范式扩展到三维：一个绕三个轴旋转的凸多面体被一个固定的水平平面切割，所得截面产生一个由物体方向控制的连续变化的多边形。该系统在RNBO（Cycling~'74）中运行，采用几何缓存策略以避免逐样本重新计算。抗锯齿结合了从运行时贝塞尔切线推导出的四点polyBLAMP校正和自适应过采样，校正几何形状适应于一般顶点配置，无需逐形状解析推导。

articles.title: Lost in Speech: Trilingual Spoken Hallucination Detection Across Audio and Transcripts
articles.abstract: While text-based hallucination detection has been extensively studied, spoken hallucination detection remains largely unexplored, particularly for low-resource languages. We present the first multilingual spoken hallucination benchmark comprising 12,013 news samples across English, Russian, and Kazakh with controlled hallucinations of three types and three severity levels. Samples comprise original articles and aligned hallucinated counterparts in text and audio. We complement the synthetic corpus with 290 fact-checked fake news items collected natively in Russian (225) and Kazakh (65), translated into the other language and rendered through the same TTS-ASR pipeline. We assess fine-tuned multilingual encoders and, in zero-shot in-context settings, multimodal decoder models on transcript-based versus direct audio processing. Transcript-based detection generally outperforms direct audio processing, with binary-task degradation for strong encoders tracking per-language ASR error. On real-world fakes, synthetic-trained detectors transfer strongly (macro-F1 0.82-0.88 on original text), while Russian provenance analysis reveals both veracity-related and model-dependent machine-style signals, quantifying a key confound in synthetic hallucination benchmarks.
articles.titleCn: 迷失于言语：跨音频与文本的三语 spoken 幻觉检测
articles.abstractCn: 尽管基于文本的幻觉检测已被广泛研究，但语音幻觉检测仍基本未得到探索，尤其是在低资源语言领域。我们提出了首个多语言语音幻觉基准，包含12,013个英语、俄语和哈萨克语的新闻样本，其中包含三种类型、三个严重程度的受控幻觉。样本包括原始文章及其在文本和音频中对齐的幻觉版本。我们用290个经过事实核查的虚假新闻项补充了合成语料库，这些新闻项以俄语（225个）和哈萨克语（65个）本地收集，并翻译成其他语言，通过相同的TTS-ASR流程进行渲染。我们评估了微调的多语言编码器，以及在基于文本转录与直接音频处理的无上下文多模态解码模型。基于文本的检测通常优于直接音频处理，对于强编码器，二元任务退化与每种语言的ASR错误成正比。在真实世界的虚假新闻中，合成训练的检测器表现出强大的迁移能力（在原始文本上宏观F1达到0.82-0.88），而俄语来源分析揭示了与真实性相关和模型依赖的机器风格信号，量化了合成幻觉基准中的关键混杂因素。

articles.title: The Annotation Bottleneck in Persian Text NLP: Persian as an Annotation-Scarce Language
articles.abstract: Persian (Farsi) is often described as a low-resource language in natural language processing, but that label collapses distinct shortages into a single category. This paper argues that Persian is more precisely described as annotation-scarce, provided that the term is understood as a property of its NLP resource ecology rather than an intrinsic property of the language. The review covers 34 representative Persian text resources available by July 2026 and adds three quantitative cross-checks. First, independent web measurements place Persian among roughly the twenty most visible content languages: W3Techs reports Persian on about 0.9% of websites with a known content language, while Common Crawl CC-MAIN-2026-30 identifies Persian as the primary language of 0.7039% of HTML pages. Second, a selective speech review shows a long resource trajectory from FARSDAT to recent corpora containing hundreds or thousands of hours of speech. Third, a matched Persian-English comparison normalizes task-specific annotation volumes by relative Common Crawl web presence. The resulting ratios vary sharply: Persian syntax and news NER are comparatively dense, whereas natural-language inference falls below the web-proportional baseline. The evidence therefore does not support a simple claim that Persian is globally deficient in labeled volume. Instead, annotation scarcity is expressed through uneven task and domain coverage, incompatible schemes, access and documentation friction, and limited supervision for specialist domains, preference data, and varieties beyond standard Iranian Persian.
articles.titleCn: 波斯文本NLP中的标注瓶颈：波斯语作为一种标注稀缺语言
articles.abstractCn: 波斯语（法尔斯语）在自然语言处理领域常被描述为低资源语言，但这种标签将不同的短缺归并为单一类别。本文认为，波斯语更精确地应被描述为标注稀缺，前提是这一术语被理解为其自然语言处理资源生态系统的属性，而非语言本身的固有属性。该综述涵盖了截至2026年7月可用的34种代表性波斯语文本资源，并补充了三项定量的交叉验证。首先，独立网络测量将波斯语列在约二十种最可见内容语言之中：W3Techs报告称波斯语约占已知内容语言的0.9%网站使用，而Common Crawl CC-MAIN-2026-30将波斯语识别为0.7039%HTML页面的主要语言。其次，选择性语音综述显示资源轨迹从FARSDAT延伸至包含数百或数千小时语音的近期语料库。第三，匹配的波斯语-英语比较通过相对Common Crawl网络存在度对特定任务标注量进行标准化。结果差异显著：波斯语句法和新闻命名实体识别相对密集，而自然语言推理则低于网络比例基准。因此，证据并不支持波斯语在全球标注量上普遍匮乏的简单论断。相反，标注稀缺通过任务和领域覆盖不均、不兼容的方案、访问和文档摩擦，以及针对专业领域、偏好数据和标准伊朗波斯语以外变体的有限监督表现出来。

articles.title: Confident at the moment of action: belief miscalibration in LLM play under hidden information
articles.abstract: Agentic systems increasingly gate actions on a model's own stated confidence, which assumes confidence tracks correctness at the moment of acting. We test this in a hidden-information chess variant where royal status can be secretly, repeatedly relocated between pieces, and where an agent's stated probability distribution over the opponent's hidden royal piece -- elicited every turn, separately from the move it chooses -- is scored against ground truth recoverable after the game. Across two independent batches, captures made at high stated confidence ($\geq 0.5$) about the hidden piece's location were correct in 1 of 62 cases. The calibration deficit is concentrated almost entirely in these events: 99.3% of it in the original batch, 98.7% in the replication. The same pattern, in weaker form, orders consistently (point estimates only; most pairwise gaps are not statistically distinguishable at this sample size) across four further model configurations spanning a second provider -- reported as scope for the finding, not as evidence that capability predicts calibration: a same-model comparison at a fixed external leaderboard score shows a deliberation-budget change alone moves the metric by nearly as much as a large cross-model gap. In a separate seat, conventional evaluation axes -- legality, cost, latency, completion rate -- can dissociate entirely from belief quality, with the configuration winning on every conventional axis producing the worst belief quality tested. A model exhibiting this pattern can still win the game its belief was about, which is why outcome-only evaluation would not detect it.
articles.titleCn: 行动时刻的自信：隐藏信息下大型语言模型博弈中的信念错配
articles.abstractCn: 自主系统越来越多地根据模型自身声明的置信度来限制行动，这种做法假设置信度在行动时刻能够反映正确性。我们在一个隐藏信息的棋类变体中对此进行了测试，在这个变体中，王者的身份可以在棋子之间秘密、反复地转移，并且智能体在每一轮中声明的关于对手隐藏王者棋子的概率分布——独立于其选择的行动——会被与游戏结束后可恢复的真实情况进行评分。在两个独立的批次中，关于隐藏棋子位置的高置信度捕获（$\geq 0.5$）仅在一个62次尝试中正确。校准缺陷几乎完全集中在这类事件中：原始批次中有99.3%，复制批次中有98.7%。相同模式以较弱的程度出现在其他四个进一步模型配置中，这些配置跨越了第二个提供者——这被视为该发现的适用范围，而非能力预测校准的证据：在固定外部排行榜分数下的同一模型比较显示，仅改变思考预算就能使指标变化几乎与大型跨模型差距相当。在另一个独立方面，传统评估轴——合法性、成本、延迟、完成率——可以完全与信念质量脱钩，在所有传统轴上获胜的配置产生了测试中最差的信念质量。表现出这种模式的模型仍然可能赢得其信念所针对的游戏，这就是为什么仅基于结果的评价无法检测到它。

articles.title: One Timeline, Many Renderings: A Wolfram Language Paclet for heterogeneous musical output
articles.abstract: One algorithmic composition may require a Csound score, engraved notation, real-time control, and a rehearsal click. Authored separately, their timelines drift. Temporal System is a Wolfram Language paclet that instead compiles one immutable store of typed entities on a rational beat timeline through backend-specific contracts. It emits Csound synthesis, beta MusicXML 4.0, OSC control, and click artifacts that remain synchronized because they share that store. Conversion to seconds, samples, or hertz occurs only at render time. Csound notes use stable named instruments in external .orc files; curves become k-rate signals declared against score p-fields. The click backend derives rehearsal audio from the same meter and tempo and reuses the Csound serializer. We describe the temporal, semantic, and rendering-contract layers, their practical trade-offs, and the limits of this proprietary authoring environment within an otherwise open-source ecosystem. The archived supplement exposes the reported outputs pending paclet release.

articles.titleCn: 一条时间线，多种渲染：一个用于异构音乐输出的Wolfram语言Paclet
articles.abstractCn: 一种算法作曲可能需要Csound乐谱、雕刻式记谱、实时控制和排练节拍。若分别创作，它们的时序线会漂移。Temporal System是一个基于Wolfram语言的paclet，它通过特定后端合约，在有理节拍时序线上编译一个不可变的、类型化的实体存储。它生成Csound合成、beta MusicXML 4.0、OSC控制和节拍效果，这些输出因共享同一存储而保持同步。转换到秒、样本或赫兹仅在渲染时发生。Csound音符使用外部.orc文件中的稳定命名乐器；曲线变为针对乐谱p字段的k-rate信号。节拍后端从相同的时间尺度和节奏中提取排练音频，并复用Csound序列化器。我们描述了时序、语义和渲染合约层，它们的实际权衡，以及这一专有创作环境在整体开源生态系统中的局限性。存档的补充材料展示了在paclet发布前报告的输出。

articles.title: The Invisible Editorial Layer: Formalizing Undisclosed Inference-Time Steering, Probability Placement, and the Attribution Problem in Deployed Language Models
articles.abstract: Evaluations of generative language models frequently interpret observable behavioral traits, such as political stance, brand inclination, and normative framing, as manifestations of model weights, post-training alignment, or prompting. This interpretation risks conflating a foundation model with the multi-layered production system through which its outputs are ultimately served. Modern inference stacks support runtime interventions capable of modifying generation while model parameters remain frozen. We examine inference-time framing bias: systematic runtime steering of generated text toward institutional, ideological, or commercial frames without requiring changes to the underlying model parameters. We formalize the Inference Attribution Problem and establish an observational non-identifiability result showing that, under black-box observation alone, behaviorally equivalent deployed systems may arise from structurally distinct combinations of model parameters and inference policies. Consequently, observed behavioral bias does not uniquely identify the architectural layer responsible for it. We further characterize Probability Placement as a deployment pattern in which undisclosed commercial influence is embedded within an ostensibly organic assistant response through systematic probability-mass reallocation, distinguishing it from explicit token-auction mechanisms for generative advertising. Finally, we discuss implications for behavioral auditing, inference provenance, confidential computing, cryptographic attestation, the EU AI Act, the Digital Services Act, and advertising-disclosure principles. We argue that governance of generative systems must increasingly distinguish between auditing a model and auditing the deployed system that ultimately speaks.
articles.comment: Substantially revised version with a formal non-identifiability result for the Inference Attribution Problem, expanded related work, and extended analysis of Probability Placement, auditing, and runtime transparency
articles.titleCn: 隐形的编辑层：形式化部署语言模型中的未披露推理时引导、概率放置及归因问题
articles.abstractCn: 生成式语言模型的评估经常将可观察的行为特征，如政治立场、品牌倾向和规范框架，解释为模型权重、训练后对齐或提示的表现。这种解释有将基础模型与其最终输出所经过的多层生产系统混淆的风险。现代推理栈支持在模型参数冻结时进行运行时干预，从而能够修改生成内容。我们研究了推理时框架偏差：系统性地将生成文本引导至制度、意识形态或商业框架，而无需更改底层模型参数。我们形式化了推理归因问题，并建立了一个观察非可识别性结果，表明在仅通过黑盒观察的情况下，行为上等效的部署系统可能源自结构上不同的模型参数和推理策略组合。因此，观察到的行为偏差并不能唯一确定负责该偏差的架构层。我们进一步将概率放置描述为一种部署模式，其中未公开的商业影响通过系统性的概率质量重新分配嵌入看似有机的助手响应中，从而区别于生成式广告的显式代币拍卖机制。最后，我们讨论了对行为审计、推理溯源、机密计算、密码学验证、欧盟人工智能法案、数字服务法案和广告披露原则的影响。我们认为，生成式系统的治理必须越来越区分对模型的审计和对最终发声的部署系统的审计。

articles.title: From local kernels to global form: modeling the emergence of musical content
articles.abstract: Markov models are established tools for symbolic music, including non-homogeneous formulations. The narrower contribution examined here is an observation-driven estimation mechanism: overlapping sliding windows derive a trajectory of local transition kernels from one symbolic sequence rather than from an exogenous formal partition. We test this mechanism on 273 logical note events from Debussy's Syrinx (1913), using the often-proposed A-B-A' reading as a reference rather than ground truth. We apply the same validation to absolute-pitch and notated-duration kernels. At $L=6$, both reference boundaries attain the Jensen--Shannon maximum in both dimensions; the duration plateau is substantially narrower (64 of 267 comparisons) than the pitch plateau (210 of 267). Because the theoretical maximum for consecutive sliding-window comparisons is set by window geometry and equals $1/\sqrt{L-1}$ for maximal turnover of the entering/leaving transition, the pitch value at $L=6$ and its broad plateau are not, by themselves, strong evidence. Their cross-dimensional alignment is consistent with boundary sensitivity, while the broad plateaus preclude treating either curve alone as a unique automatic segmenter. Five-hundred-draw re-synthesis experiments quantify departure from the source in both dimensions and expose an exact-copy degeneracy at $L=2$.

articles.titleCn: 从局部核到全局形式：建模音乐内容的涌现
articles.abstractCn: 马尔可夫模型是符号音乐分析中成熟的工具，包括非齐次形式。此处考察的贡献是一种基于观察的估计机制：重叠滑动窗口从一个符号序列中推导出局部转移核轨迹，而非来自外部的形式划分。我们在德彪西的《西林斯》（1913）273个逻辑音符事件上测试该机制，并以常用的A-B-A'解读作为参考而非真实标准。我们对绝对音高和记谱时值核应用相同的验证。在$L=6$时，两个参考边界在两个维度上均达到Jensen-Shannon最大值；时值平台显著窄于音高平台（64次比较中的267次）（210次比较中的267次）。由于连续滑动窗口比较的理论最大值由窗口几何形状决定，且在进入/离开转移最大周转时等于$1/\sqrt{L-1}$，因此$L=6$时的音高值及其宽平台本身并非强有力证据。它们的跨维度一致性符合边界敏感性，而宽平台则排除了单独将任一曲线视为唯一自动分割器的可能性。五百次重合成实验量化了两个维度上的源偏离程度，并揭示了$L=2$时的精确复制退化现象。

articles.title: Expectation, Backlash, Recovery, and Excitement: How Model Releases Shape Reddit Perceptions of Conversational AI Systems
articles.abstract: Conversational AI systems (CAISes) continuously change through model releases, feature updates, safety interventions, and access-policy shifts, yet user perceptions are often studied as static snapshots. We conduct a long-term, large-scale analysis of Reddit discussions to examine how users perceive CAIS model release interventions across providers. By combining sentiment classification and thematic concept analysis, we show that CAIS perceptions are dynamic and intervention-sensitive. Anthropic exhibits the clearest positive release profile through Claude Code and product-model fit, OpenAI shows backlash-and-recovery dynamics around GPT-5 and GPT-5.1, Grok-3 is shaped by provider identity and political discourse, and DeepSeek-R1 combines engineering praise with concerns about censorship, access, and reliability. These findings show that model releases are not merely technical updates, but user-facing interventions that reshape sentiment, expectations, and public discussion.
articles.comment: Accepted at EMNLP 2026 Main Conference. The companion website is available at https://vavre.github.io/p/upai
articles.titleCn: 期望、反弹、恢复与兴奋：模型发布如何塑造Reddit对对话式人工智能系统的认知
articles.abstractCn: 对话式人工智能系统（CAIS）通过模型发布、功能更新、安全干预和访问策略调整等持续变化，但用户认知往往被研究为静态快照。我们通过对Reddit讨论进行长期大规模分析，考察用户如何感知不同提供者的CAIS模型发布干预措施。通过结合情感分类和主题概念分析，我们表明CAIS认知是动态且对干预敏感的。Anthropic通过Claude Code和产品模型契合度展现出最清晰的正向发布特征，OpenAI围绕GPT-5和GPT-5.1呈现反噬与恢复的动态，Grok-3受提供者身份和政治话语影响，DeepSeek-R1结合了对工程技术的赞誉与对审查、访问和可靠性的担忧。这些发现表明模型发布不仅是技术更新，更是面向用户的干预措施，重塑了情感、预期和公共讨论。

articles.title: Beyond Semantic Accuracy: Consequence-Aware Evaluation for Safety-Critical Language Understanding
articles.abstract: Can language models be trusted in safety- critical operations? In such settings, strong per- formance on semantic metrics does not guaran- tee operational reliability: a misread altitude, a dropped execution condition, or a confused call- sign may score well under standard F1 yet carry sharply asymmetric operational consequences. We study this problem in air traffic control (ATC), where controller-pilot communication demands near-zero error tolerance, and use consequence-aware evaluation to test whether semantic scores misstate operational reliabil- ity. The framework is instantiated in a con- trolled diagnostic ATC benchmark grounded in aviation standards and feedback from 40 air traffic controllers across three countries. Evaluating 8 models, we uncover a system- atic semantic-safety gap: conventional scores give substantially higher performance estimates than consequence-aware evaluation, even for models that appear reliable under standard met- rics. Risk-aware fine-tuning narrows but does not close this gap, showing that consequence- aware evaluation is a necessary complement to standard NLP metrics before any real safety- critical deployment claim
articles.titleCn: 超越语义准确性：面向安全关键型语言理解的后果感知评估
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型在安全关键操作中是否值得信赖？在这样的环境中，语义指标上的优异表现并不能保证操作可靠性：一个误读的高度、一个遗漏的执行条件，或是一个混淆的呼号，在标准F1分数下可能得分很高，却可能带来严重的不对称操作后果。我们研究了空中交通管制（ATC）中的这个问题，其中管制员与飞行员之间的通信要求近乎零误差容忍度，并使用后果感知评估来检验语义分数是否错误地陈述了操作可靠性。该框架在一个基于航空标准和来自三个国家40名空中交通管制员反馈的受控诊断ATC基准中得到实例化。评估了8个模型，我们发现了一个系统性的语义-安全差距：传统评分给出的性能估计远高于后果感知评估，即使对于在标准指标下看似可靠的模型也是如此。风险感知微调缩小了但并未消除这个差距，表明后果感知评估是在任何实际安全关键部署声明之前，对标准NLP指标的一个必要补充。

articles.title: Quantization Effects on Bangla Language Understanding in Large Language Models: A Systematic Evaluation
articles.abstract: Post-training quantization lowers the memory footprint of Large Language Models (LLMs) and speeds up inference, which is why it is now common for on-device deployment. Most of what we know about its effects, however, comes from English benchmarks. It is not clear whether the same holds for morphologically complex, low-resource languages such as Bangla, and this gap is what we address here. We evaluate three model families---Qwen-2.5-7B, LLaMA-3.1-8B, and GPT-OSS-20B---in full precision and in three quantized formats (GPTQ-Int8, GPTQ-Q8, GGUF-W8A16) across five Bangla natural language understanding benchmarks (Bangla MMLU, CommonsenseQA-BN, OpenBookQA-BN, PIQA-BN, and BoolQ-BN), using zero-shot evaluation through lm-evaluation-harness. To our knowledge this is the first controlled comparison of quantization formats on Bangla NLU. The three families do not respond the same way: GPT-OSS loses up to 57.35% accuracy on reasoning-heavy tasks under GGUF-W8A16, while Qwen and LLaMA hold steady under GPTQ, and in a few cases the quantized version edges out the full-precision one. BoolQ-BN, a comprehension task, stays stable across all three families regardless of format. Taken together, these results suggest quantization can work well for Bangla deployment, but the choice of architecture and quantization method matters more than the bit width alone. We discuss what this means for practitioners choosing a model to run on constrained hardware.
articles.titleCn: 量化对大型语言模型中孟加拉语理解的影响：系统评估
articles.abstractCn: 训练后量化降低了大型语言模型（LLMs）的内存占用并加速了推理，这也是它在设备上部署变得普遍的原因。然而，我们对量化效果的了解大多来自英语基准测试。对于孟加拉语等形态复杂、资源有限的语言，目前尚不清楚同样的效果是否适用，而这正是我们在此解决的问题。我们使用lm-evaluation-harness通过零样本评估，在孟加拉语自然语言理解基准测试（孟加拉语MMLU、CommonsenseQA-BN、OpenBookQA-BN、PIQA-BN和BoolQ-BN）上，对三种模型家族——Qwen-2.5-7B、LLaMA-3.1-8B和GPT-OSS-20B——在完整精度和三种量化格式（GPTQ-Int8、GPTQ-Q8、GGUF-W8A16）下进行评估。据我们所知，这是首次对孟加拉语NLU的量化格式进行受控比较。这三个家族的反应并不相同：在GGUF-W8A16下，GPT-OSS在推理密集型任务上损失了高达57.35%的准确率，而Qwen和LLaMA在GPTQ下表现稳定，甚至在某些情况下，量化版本超过了完整精度版本。BoolQ-BN是一项理解任务，在所有三个家族中，无论格式如何，都保持稳定。综合来看，这些结果表明量化对于孟加拉语部署可以表现良好，但架构选择和量化方法的重要性超过了比特宽度本身。我们讨论了这对在受限硬件上选择运行模型的从业者意味着什么。

articles.title: Is Discrete Difficulty Sufficient? Leveraging Continuous Difficulty for Efficient Self-Consistency in LLMs
articles.abstract: Self-Consistency (SC) is a decoding strategy that samples diverse reasoning paths and selects the most consistent answer, demonstrating strong performance on complex reasoning problems. However, the excessive token consumption incurred by generating multiple reasoning paths has been identified as a major limitation of SC. To improve computational efficiency, several studies have proposed strategies that adjust the number of reasoning paths or allocate resources differentially according to problem difficulty. Nevertheless, most existing methods categorize difficulty into a few fixed levels, failing to fully capture the continuously varying nature of reasoning complexity. In this work, we propose Flexible Self-Consistency (FSC), which estimates problem difficulty as a continuous signal and dynamically adjusts the number of generated reasoning paths accordingly. FSC predicts the output entropy of an input question using a pre-trained probe and leverages it as an indicator of model uncertainty to flexibly control the sampling budget. Experimental results show that, across various models and benchmarks, FSC maintains accuracy comparable to SC while achieving token savings of up to 76%.
articles.titleCn: 离散难度是否足够？利用连续难度实现LLM中的高效自洽
articles.abstractCn: 自洽性（SC）是一种解码策略，它通过采样多样化的推理路径并选择最一致的答案，在复杂的推理问题上展现出优异的性能。然而，生成多个推理路径所导致的过度token消耗已被识别为SC的主要局限性。为了提高计算效率，一些研究提出了调整推理路径数量或根据问题难度差异化分配资源的策略。尽管如此，大多数现有方法将难度分为几个固定的级别，未能充分捕捉推理复杂性的连续变化特性。在这项工作中，我们提出了灵活自洽性（FSC），它将问题难度估计为一个连续信号，并据此动态调整生成的推理路径数量。FSC使用预训练的探针预测输入问题的输出熵，并将其作为模型不确定性的指标，以灵活地控制采样预算。实验结果表明，在多种模型和基准测试中，FSC在保持与SC相当准确性的同时，实现了高达76%的token节省。

articles.title: Beyond Information Seeking: Severity-Aware Question Supervision for Proactive Medical Dialogue
articles.abstract: Proactive medical dialogue requires an agent to decide what to ask from incomplete patient information. Existing information-seeking approaches commonly prioritize questions that most reduce diagnostic uncertainty. While effective for acquiring informative evidence, this criterion overlooks an important property of medical diagnosis: different diagnostic errors can carry substantially different consequences. Missing a severe condition may matter more than reducing uncertainty among less consequential alternatives. Question acquisition should therefore consider not only how informative new evidence is, but also how it is expected to affect the downstream diagnostic decision. To this end, we propose Expected-Severity-Risk (ESR), a consequence-aware question-supervision objective that values each candidate by its expected reduction in severity-aware terminal risk. Because questions must be selected before their answers are observed, ESR marginalizes over possible answers using train-only population statistics. Its rankings are then distilled into a prefix-only language policy, so next-question selection requires no teacher-side computation at deployment. Across three Qwen3-4B training seeds on DDxPlus, matched ESR supervision reduces mean high-severity diagnostic miss from .0645 to .0455 (-29.5%) and improves mean diagnostic accuracy from .9123 to .9320 while requiring only 0.14 additional questions per dialogue. Fixed-budget analyses show that the two objectives remain behaviorally distinct when question count is controlled, while a matched expected-0/1-risk control shows that severity-aware weighting improves the high-severity error profile beyond generic decision-aware supervision. These results support moving proactive medical dialogue beyond uncertainty reduction toward consequence-aware evidence acquisition.
articles.titleCn: 超越信息检索：基于严重程度感知的主动医疗对话问题监督
articles.abstractCn: 主动医疗对话需要代理根据不完整的患者信息决定询问什么。现有的信息获取方法通常优先考虑那些最能减少诊断不确定性的问题。虽然这种方法对于获取信息丰富的证据有效，但它忽略了医学诊断的一个重要特性：不同的诊断错误可能带来截然不同的后果。错过一种严重疾病可能比在后果较轻的替代方案中减少不确定性更为重要。因此，问题获取不仅要考虑新证据的信息量，还要考虑它预期如何影响下游的诊断决策。为此，我们提出了预期严重风险（ESR），这是一个考虑后果的问题监督目标，它通过每个候选问题预期减少的严重风险感知终端风险来评估其价值。由于问题必须在观察到答案之前被选择，ESR使用仅训练人口的统计数据对可能的答案进行边缘化。然后将其排名提炼成一个仅前缀的语言策略，因此下一次问题选择在部署时不需要教师端的计算。在DDxPlus上的三个Qwen3-4B训练种子中，匹配的ESR监督将平均高严重性诊断遗漏从0.0645降至0.0455（-29.5%），同时将平均诊断准确率从0.9123提高到0.9320，而对话中仅需额外0.14个问题。固定预算分析表明，当问题数量受控时，这两个目标在行为上仍然不同，而匹配的预期0/1风险控制显示，严重风险感知加权在通用决策感知监督之外改善了高严重性错误特征。这些结果支持将主动医疗对话从减少不确定性转向考虑后果的证据获取。

articles.title: When Do Supervised UQ Ensembles Improve LLM Hallucination Detection? A Robustness Study
articles.abstract: Uncertainty quantification (UQ) methods are widely used for hallucination detection in large language models (LLMs) in closed-book settings where ground-truth evidence is unavailable at inference time. Prior work has proposed combining UQ signals via learned ensembles, but empirical investigations into the robustness of these ensembles are limited. We study a supervised ensembling framework that trains a classifier over heterogeneous UQ-based scorer outputs on a small, domain-specific dataset of labeled LLM responses, then applies it to out-of-sample hallucination classification without retrieval, tools, or reference documents. Across four LLMs, nine datasets, and three generation regimes (short-form QA, long-form generation, and code generation), we provide a systematic robustness analysis along three axes: sample efficiency, in-domain dataset transfer, and generation regime dependence. We find that supervised ensembles outperform the best individual scorer in 30 of 32 settings, with gains realized from as few as 100 labeled instances. Ensembles retain most of their advantage in cases of in-domain transfer under distribution shift, outperforming the best non-ensemble scorer in 23 of 28 transfer settings. Sampling-based black-box ensembles are nearly as effective as full ensembles, while single-generation white-box ensembles offer limited benefit.
articles.titleCn: 何时监督不确定性量化集成能提升大型语言模型的幻觉检测？一项鲁棒性研究
articles.abstractCn: 不确定性量化（UQ）方法在无法在推理时获取真实证据的封闭式环境下被广泛应用于大型语言模型（LLM）中的幻觉检测。已有研究提出通过学习集成来组合UQ信号，但对这些集成鲁棒性的实证研究有限。我们研究了一种监督集成框架，该框架在少量特定领域的标注LLM响应数据集上训练一个分类器，用于处理异构UQ评分器输出，然后将其应用于无需检索、工具或参考文档的样本外幻觉分类。在四个LLM、九个数据集和三种生成模式（短式问答、长式生成和代码生成）中，我们从三个维度——样本效率、领域内数据集迁移和生成模式依赖性——进行了系统的鲁棒性分析。我们发现，在32种设置中的30种情况下，监督集成优于最佳单个评分器，且仅需100个标注实例即可实现性能提升。在领域内迁移情况下，集成在分布偏移下仍保留大部分优势，在28种迁移设置中优于最佳非集成评分器。基于采样的黑盒集成几乎与完整集成同样有效，而单次生成的白盒集成则提供有限益处。

articles.title: Beyond Static Interpretability: Anticipating Post-SFT Mechanisms from Pre-SFT Parameters for Better Tuning
articles.abstract: Mechanistic Localization bridges mechanistic interpretability and post-training optimization by isolating critical parameters via interpretative approaches and then guiding parameter-efficient Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) in a ``locating-then-tuning'' paradigm. However, due to the retrospective nature of mechanistic interpretability, directly interpreting pre-SFT models introduces misleading conclusions. Specifically for novel tasks, initially identified neurons differ drastically from those governing the final model, introducing biases that actively disrupt SFT. To address this, we propose a forward-looking localization framework that accurately estimates the post-SFT interpretability state using only pre-SFT parameters and the target dataset. Theoretically, we model SFT as a continuous parameter evolution, leveraging Taylor expansion to rigorously bridge the post-tuning mechanistic objective with the pre-SFT model's dynamic gradients. Practically, we design dual-granularity (neuron- and component-level) localization pipelines. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach not only provides superior SFT guidance but also exhibits robust performance and temporal scalability across increasing model sizes. This work transcends the fundamental limitation of traditional interpretability-its inability to identify task-critical mechanisms before they are trained-pioneering a predictive frontier that unites mechanistic interpretability with targeted optimization.
articles.titleCn: 超越静态可解释性：从预SFT参数中预测后SFT机制以实现更好的调优
articles.abstractCn: 机制定位通过解释性方法隔离关键参数，并在“定位后调优”范式下引导参数高效的监督微调（SFT），从而连接机制可解释性和训练后优化。然而，由于机制可解释性的回顾性本质，直接解释预SFT模型会导致误导性结论。具体到新任务，最初识别的神经元与最终模型中的控制神经元差异巨大，从而引入主动破坏SFT的偏差。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种前瞻性定位框架，仅使用预SFT参数和目标数据集来精确估计SFT后的可解释状态。理论上，我们将SFT建模为连续参数演化，利用泰勒展开将调优后的机制目标与预SFT模型的动态梯度严格关联。实践中，我们设计了双粒度（神经元和组件级）定位流程。大量实验表明，我们的方法不仅提供了卓越的SFT指导，而且在模型规模增加时展现出鲁棒性能和时间可扩展性。这项工作超越了传统可解释性的基本局限——即在机制被训练之前无法识别任务关键机制，开创了一个将机制可解释性与目标优化相结合的预测性前沿。

articles.title: Dataset Scarcity Limits Robust Evaluation of Multilingual Embedding Models: A Case Study of Slavic Languages
articles.abstract: Multilingual text embedding models enable cross-lingual transfer of knowledge across a wide range of NLP tasks, but their evaluation remains highly uneven across high-, mid- and low-resource languages. In this paper, we propose a two-dimensional framework, specifically tailored for analyzing multilingual embedding benchmarks under dataset scarcity, and apply it on the Slavic-language subset of the MTEB benchmark. The framework distinguishes between task-specific and cross-task evaluation, while jointly analyzing three complementary aspects: (1) ranking robustness, (2) model consistency, and (3) evidence strength. At the task-specific level, we evaluate the stability of model rankings under changes in ranking methodology and benchmark dataset composition. At the cross-task level, we assess the ability of models to generalize across diverse tasks within a language. To quantify the reliability of benchmark conclusions, we introduce an Evidence Strength Score that accounts for dataset availability, diversity, and robustness assessability. Our analysis reveals severe benchmark sparsity, with many Slavic language-task pairs relying on a single dataset or highly correlated benchmark collections, limiting the ability to draw robust conclusions. The cross-task analysis reveals a small group of highly transferable models, most notably llama-embed-nemotron-8b, multilingual-e5-large-instruct, and Qwen3-Embedding variants, that consistently perform well across Slavic languages and tasks. Overall, the results demonstrate that benchmark rankings and robustness conclusions must be interpreted jointly with certain notation of their evidence strength and highlight benchmark scarcity as a major obstacle to trustworthy multilingual evaluation.
articles.titleCn: 数据集稀缺限制了多语言嵌入模型的鲁棒性评估：斯拉夫语言案例研究
articles.abstractCn: 多语言文本嵌入模型能够在广泛的自然语言处理任务中实现跨语言知识迁移，但其评估在不同资源量（高、中、低）语言之间仍存在显著不均衡。本文提出一个二维框架，专门针对数据集稀缺情况下的多语言嵌入基准分析，并将其应用于MTEB基准的斯拉夫语子集。该框架区分任务特定评估和跨任务评估，同时联合分析三个方面：(1) 排序鲁棒性，(2) 模型一致性，以及 (3) 证据强度。在任务特定层面，我们评估模型排序在排序方法变化和基准数据集构成变化下的稳定性；在跨任务层面，我们评估模型在语言内不同任务间的泛化能力。为量化基准结论的可靠性，我们引入证据强度评分，该评分考虑数据集可用性、多样性和鲁棒性可评估性。分析揭示基准严重稀疏，许多斯拉夫语-任务对依赖单一数据集或高度相关的基准集合，限制了得出稳健结论的能力。跨任务分析发现一小部分高度可迁移模型，尤其是 llama-embed-nemotron-8b、multilingual-e5-large-instruct 和 Qwen3-Embedding 变体，在斯拉夫语和任务中始终表现优异。总体而言，结果表明基准排名和稳健性结论必须结合其证据强度进行解读，并强调基准稀缺是可信多语言评估的主要障碍。

articles.title: Ockhamareto: Pareto-Gated Segment-Level Credit Assignment for Concise Unit-Test Generation with Reinforcement Learning
articles.abstract: We introduce \textbf{Ockhamareto}, a single-shot GRPO framework for unit-test generation and selection, based on the principles of \emph{Ockham's Razor} and \emph{Pareto Optimality}. Ockhamareto has two principal components: (i)~a \emph{Pareto-gated Bonus} that rewards only rollouts non-dominated in~(mutation, $-$\#tests) space, and (ii)~\emph{Token-level Segment Credit}, which attributes each test's marginal mutation kills back to the tokens of its unit-test block. On the \emph{UnLeakedTestBench~(ULT)}, Ockhamareto \emph{strictly Pareto-dominates} the strongest RL baseline~(\emph{MIST-RL}). Furthermore, it dominates on {\em each and all} optimization objectives, catching more bugs ($49.9\%$ vs $31.3\%$ mutation score at $N{=}5$), using \emph{fewer} tests ($2.60$ vs $4.67$ on average), thereby achieving $3.4\times$ the per-test trade-off improvement. The advantage is found in all four benchmarks~(\emph{HumanEval+}, \emph{MBPP+}, \emph{CodeContests}, \emph{TestGenEval-Lite}): Ockhamareto leads both mutation and coverage metrics on every one, always with the smallest suite. Ockhamareto also outperforms the state-of-the-art at all model scales, adding $+30$--$35$~pp mutation at 4B, 9B, and 27B model sizes. We also show that the knee point of the optimal trade-off between efficiency and effectiveness on the Pareto front is not correlated with obvious more easily computed proxy metrics, such as function size. This finding motivates the Pareto front computation; it is needed to identify this crucial engineering trade-off for each function under test.
articles.titleCn: 奥卡姆aretto：基于强化学习的精简单元测试生成中的帕累托门控段级信用分配
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了 \textbf{Ockhamareto}，这是一个基于 \emph{奥卡姆剃刀} 原则和 \emph{帕累托最优} 原则的单次运行 GRPO 框架，用于单元测试生成和选择。Ockhamareto 包含两个主要组件：(i) 一个 \emph{帕累托门控奖励}，仅奖励在 (变异，测试数量) 空间中非支配的运行结果，以及 (ii) \emph{token 级段信用}，将每个测试的边际变异杀灭归因于其单元测试块的 token。在 \emph{UnLeakedTestBench~(ULT)} 上，Ockhamareto \emph{严格帕累托支配} 最强的 RL 基线 \emph{MIST-RL}。此外，它在所有优化目标上均占优，发现更多错误（在 N=5 时，变异得分为 49.9% 对比 31.3%），使用更少的测试（平均 2.60 对比 4.67），从而实现了 3.4 倍的每测试权衡改进。这种优势在所有四个基准测试（\emph{HumanEval+}, \emph{MBPP+}, \emph{CodeContests}, \emph{TestGenEval-Lite}）中均有体现：Ockhamareto 在每个基准测试中均领先变异和覆盖率指标，且始终使用最小的测试套件。Ockhamareto 在所有模型规模上也优于当前最优方法，在 4B、9B 和 27B 模型大小下分别提升了 +30 至 +35 pp 的变异。我们还证明，帕累托前沿上效率与效果最优权衡的拐点与更易计算的代理指标（如函数大小）无关。这一发现支持了帕累托前沿计算；它对于识别每个待测函数的关键工程权衡至关重要。

articles.title: Shortcut Before Circuit: Document Statistics Time In-Context Conflict Resolution
articles.abstract: When a context asserts two values for one fact, a model commits to a cue -- recency, repetition, position -- but natural data rarely makes these disagree, so behavior cannot reveal which. We train 26M-parameter transformers on a synthetic language where recency and rarity are exactly coextensive, and separate them with a minimal causal edit that inverts one cue while holding the truth, token count and answer position fixed. All 75 runs reach accuracy >= 0.999, including where the trivial heuristic fails, so no held-in evaluation distinguishes them. Under intervention the per-cell readout does not replicate: 13 of 25 cells differ by more than 0.3 in sign fraction across three seeds, the largest by 0.879 against a standard error of 0.025. The construction predicts this -- coextensive rules leave the objective indifferent between them -- and the variance is ordered by how much of the optimization each comparison releases. What replicates is timing: escape from a positional shortcut with a closed-form ceiling, monotone in redundancy. Probed before that escape, attribution reverses sign in 32 of 75 runs at unchanged accuracy, and gating on circuit formation is necessary but not sufficient. The corpus fixes when a mechanism appears, not which one -- a criterion for when mechanistic attribution to data is available at all, and our construction makes the unavailable case exact.
articles.titleCn: 在电路之前快捷方式：文档统计时间上下文冲突解决
articles.abstractCn: 当一个情境对同一事实断言两个值时，模型会承诺一个线索——时效性、重复性、位置性——但自然数据很少使这些线索不一致，因此行为无法揭示哪个。我们在一个时效性和稀有性完全重合的合成语言上训练了2600万参数的转换器，并通过一个最小因果编辑将它们区分开来，该编辑反转一个线索，同时保持真相、标记计数和答案位置不变。所有75次运行都达到准确率>=0.999，包括在平凡启发式方法失效的情况下，因此没有任何保留评估可以区分它们。在干预下，每个单元的读数无法复制：25个单元中有13个在三个种子中符号比例差异超过0.3，最大差异为0.879，标准误差为0.025。这种构造预测了这一点——重合规则使目标对两者保持无差别——方差按每个比较释放的优化量排序。复制的是时间：从具有闭式上限的定位捷径中逃脱，冗余单调递增。在此之前探测时，归因在75次运行中的32次反转符号，准确率保持不变，并且电路形成上的门控是必要的但不充分。语料库固定的是机制出现的时间，而不是哪个机制——这是当数据机制归因可用时的标准，而我们的构造使不可用的情况变得精确。

articles.title: Words, Spaces and Generative AI: Layers of language in contemporary architecture
articles.abstract: Language can be considered a design material in architecture, and in the context of text-to-X generative AI models becoming a common tool for architectural practice, looking more closely at language is more important now than in the past. After describing some of the important developments in linguistics starting from Wittgenstein, and including the work of Chomsky, Lakoff, conceptual and generative metaphors as proposed by Schön, this chapter connects them to contemporary architectural design and generative text-to-X tools. The chapter builds on the idea that three main forms of language intertwine in architectural design done using generative AI, namely (I) discourse (or natural language which can contain professional terminology specific to our field), (II) programming languages (which are artificial languages sitting at the basis of all computational systems), and (III) annotations (as language elements attached to pieces of data). It concludes by outlining a research agenda for connecting generative metaphors to generative AI: (a) conducting corpus linguistics studies on architectural texts (using quantitative tools such as topic modelling, and qualitative tools such as discourse analysis); (b) bringing communication theory and information studies closer to architectural research and (c) taking into account that different (natural) languages come with different affordances meaning generative and conceptual metaphors differ in relation to this.
articles.titleCn: 文字、空间与生成式人工智能：当代建筑中的语言层次
articles.abstractCn: 语言可以被视为建筑中的设计材料，随着文本到X生成式AI模型成为建筑实践中的常用工具，现在比以往任何时候都更需要深入关注语言。本章首先描述了从维特根斯坦开始的一些重要语言学发展，包括乔姆斯基、拉考夫以及Schön提出的概念和生成式隐喻，然后将这些内容与当代建筑设计以及文本到X生成式工具联系起来。本章基于一个观点，即在使用生成式AI进行建筑设计时，三种主要语言形式交织在一起，分别是（I）话语（或自然语言，其中可以包含我们领域特有的专业术语）、（II）编程语言（作为所有计算系统的基础的人工语言）以及（III）注释（作为附加在数据块上的语言元素）。本章最后概述了将生成式隐喻与生成式AI联系起来的研究议程：（a）对建筑文本进行语料库语言学研究（使用主题建模等定量工具以及话语分析等定性工具）；（b）将传播理论与信息研究更紧密地与建筑研究结合起来；（c）考虑到不同（自然）语言具有不同的可供性，这意味着生成式和概念隐喻在这方面存在差异。

articles.title: Not All Tokens Are Equal: Region-Aware Consistency Repair of Backdoors in MLLMs
articles.abstract: MLLMs are increasingly deployed in user-facing applications, yet they inherit backdoor risks from the pipelines used to construct them: triggers may reside in images, texts, or both. Existing model-level backdoor removal methods, largely designed for conventional classifiers, show limited effectiveness on MLLMs, while MLLM-specific defenses mainly operate at inference time, filtering suspicious inputs without removing the backdoor embedded in the model. To address this gap and eliminate latent backdoors from MLLMs at their source, we present RACER, a model-level repair framework motivated by a key observation: backdoors induce abnormal layer-to-layer evolution in internal representations, which we term the layer-wise inconsistency anomaly. Importantly, this anomaly is modality-dependent, concentrating primarily in the token region encoding the trigger features that the backdoor model actually relies on. RACER therefore decomposes the fused representation into visual and textual token regions, normalizes their layer-wise inconsistency separately, and recomposes them using modality-aware weights over a deep-layer window, yielding a region-aware inconsistency objective that better captures localized backdoor-induced anomalies. Through a min-max optimization, this objective drives worst-case perturbation synthesis and adversarial fine-tuning against the resulting perturbation to repair the model, suppressing the deep representational directional shifts on which backdoor behaviors rely. RACER requires only 100 clean samples and no knowledge of the trigger, attack objective, or even whether the input model contains a backdoor. Evaluations on three open-source MLLMs across 36 backdoor settings spanning image, text, and multimodal triggers show that RACER reduces the average ASR to 1.1%, reaching 0% in 32 settings, while preserving clean-task utility on both backdoor and clean models.
articles.titleCn: 并非所有令牌都相等：针对MLLMs中后门的区域感知一致性修复
articles.abstractCn: MLLMs正越来越多地部署在面向用户的应用中，但它们继承了用于构建它们的管道中的后门风险：触发器可能存在于图像、文本或两者中。现有的模型级后门移除方法主要针对传统分类器设计，在MLLMs上效果有限，而针对MLLMs的防御措施主要在推理时运行，过滤可疑输入但不移除模型中嵌入的后门。为填补这一空白并在MLLMs的源头消除潜在后门，我们提出了RACER，这是一个受关键观察启发的模型级修复框架：后门导致内部表示在层与层之间产生异常演化，我们称之为层级不一致异常。重要的是，这种异常具有模态依赖性，主要集中在编码后门模型实际依赖的触发特征的标记区域。因此，RACER将融合表示分解为视觉和文本标记区域，分别对其层级不一致进行归一化，并使用跨深层窗口的模态感知权重重新组合它们，生成一个区域感知的不一致目标，以更好地捕捉局部后门引起的异常。通过最小-最大优化，该目标驱动最坏情况扰动合成和针对扰动结果的对抗微调来修复模型，抑制后门行为依赖的深层表示方向性偏移。RACER仅需100个干净样本，无需了解触发器、攻击目标，甚至无需知道输入模型是否包含后门。在涵盖图像、文本和多模态触发器的36个后门设置中，对三个开源MLLMs的评估表明，RACER将平均ASR降低至1.1%，在32个设置中达到0%，同时在后门模型和干净模型上保持干净任务的效用。

articles.title: FARCA: Fact-Aligned Reliability-Aware Credit Assignment for Reinforcement Learning with Factual Supervision
articles.abstract: To reduce the hallucination risk caused by outcome-driven rewards in large language models trained through reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, existing mitigation approaches introduce process-level factual supervision. However, due to coarse-grained aggregation of factual signals and the lack of reliability assessment for these signals, they create a mismatch between fact verification and policy updates. We term this noisy factual credit assignment and decompose it into two aspects: credit localization ambiguity and credit reliability ambiguity. To address these issues, we propose FARCA (Fact-Aligned Reliability-Aware Credit Assignment), a policy optimization framework that transforms factual supervision into localized, reliability-weighted token-level training signals. FARCA achieves fine-grained credit localization by aligning the granularity of fact verification with that of policy updates. It further introduces counterfactual evidence attribution, which uses the dependence of a factual judgment on key evidence as an empirical proxy for verification reliability to compute reliability weights. These weights modulate factual rewards and local policy advantages, reducing the influence of potentially unreliable signals on policy optimization. Experiments across different models and multiple factual reasoning benchmarks show that FARCA significantly improves model factuality while preserving general reasoning capabilities.
articles.titleCn: FARCA：基于事实监督的强化学习中的事实对齐可靠性感知信用分配
articles.abstractCn: 为了减少在通过可验证奖励的强化学习训练的大型语言模型中，由结果导向的奖励所导致的幻觉风险，现有的缓解方法引入了过程层面的事实性监督。然而，由于事实信号存在粗粒度聚合，并且缺乏对这些信号的可靠性评估，这导致了事实验证与策略更新之间的不匹配。我们将这种现象称为噪声的事实性信用分配，并将其分解为两个方面：信用定位模糊性和信用可靠性模糊性。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了FARCA（Fact-Aligned Reliability-Aware Credit Assignment），这是一个将事实性监督转化为定位精确、可靠性加权的标记级训练信号的政策优化框架。FARCA通过将事实验证的粒度与策略更新的粒度对齐，实现了细粒度的信用定位。它进一步引入了反事实证据归因，该归因使用事实判断对关键证据的依赖作为验证可靠性的经验代理，来计算可靠性权重。这些权重调节了事实性奖励和局部策略优势，减少了潜在不可靠信号对政策优化的影响。跨不同模型和多个事实推理基准的实验表明，FARCA在保持通用推理能力的同时，显著提高了模型的事实性。

articles.title: SteerCheck: Attribution Specificity and Alignment Leakage in Activation-Steering Audits
articles.abstract: Activation steering can change behaviour without establishing that the effect is specific to the intended concept. We introduce SteerCheck, a preregistered attribution audit that matches off-target KL and separates mean, protected-tail, polarity, transfer, and semantic claims. Exact replay of 960 Qwen3-14B interventions reveals complementary limits of common controls: isotropic directions occupy a narrow near-orthogonal region, whereas sign-randomized same-construction directions often retain substantial target alignment. Effect is strongly associated with signed cosine within the sign-randomized family ($ρ=.94$); $25.3\%$ of its draws exceed cosine $.5$, and every draw exceeding the observed mean effect has cosine above $.80$. This alignment leakage does not by itself invalidate a conditional randomization test; it limits what the comparator can distinguish and motivates reporting exchangeability assumptions, a construction diagnostic $A$, and the empirical cosine distribution. The primary Qwen complete gate remains negative because the protected tail fails all families. On independent data, continuous margin transfers only in Qwen and accuracy transfers in no selected cell. Prospectively registered language controls pass the complete gate in Qwen and DeepSeek, while a passing DeepSeek detox comparator rules out categorical separation; all nominal passes are sensitive to $Γ=1.10$. Frozen three-rater open-generation evaluation supports factual correction in DeepSeek but not Qwen; the automatic judge fails calibration (macro-F1 $.562$), so null-wide semantic results remain descriptive. SteerCheck makes these conditional and mixed conclusions auditable.
articles.titleCn: SteerCheck：激活引导审核中的归因特定性和对齐泄露
articles.abstractCn: 激活引导可以改变行为，而无需证明其效果是针对预期概念特定的。我们引入了SteerCheck，这是一种预先注册的归因审计，它匹配了离靶KL，并将均值、受保护尾部、极性、迁移和语义主张进行分离。对960个Qwen3-14B干预的精确重放揭示了常见控制的互补局限性：各向同性方向占据一个狭窄的近似正交区域，而符号随机化的同结构方向往往仍保留大量目标对齐。在符号随机化家族中，效果与符号余弦强相关（$ρ=.94$）；其25.3%的抽样值超过余弦0.5，且所有超过观察到的平均效果的抽样值余弦均高于0.80。这种对齐泄漏本身并不使条件随机化测试无效；它限制了比较器能够区分的内容，并促使报告可交换性假设，这是一种结构诊断$A$，以及经验余弦分布。主要的Qwen完整门保持为负，因为受保护尾部在所有家族中均未通过。在独立数据上，连续边缘仅在Qwen中迁移，而准确率在未选择的单元格中无迁移。前瞻性注册的语言控制通过Qwen和DeepSeek的完整门，而通过DeepSeek的解毒比较器排除了分类分离；所有名义通过均对$Γ=1.10$敏感。冻结的三评开放生成评估支持DeepSeek的事实纠正，但不支持Qwen；自动裁判未能校准（宏观F1 0.562），因此零范围语义结果仍为描述性。SteerCheck使这些条件和混合结论可审计。

articles.title: SeMoCo: A Semantic-First Motion Codec for Motion Language Modeling
articles.abstract: Discrete motion representations have substantially advanced autoregressive text-to-motion generation. However, most motion tokenizers are optimized for reconstruction and do not explicitly allocate capacity according to semantic role. Action-level meaning and fine-grained kinematic detail must therefore be encoded through the same reconstruction-driven hierarchy. We introduce SeMoCo, a semantic-first motion codec, together with a dual-axis motion generator for language-conditioned motion generation. Each motion token contains one semantic token and a residual sequence of kinematic tokens. The generator models semantic progression across time and autoregressively refines the residual entries. We also construct $Ω$-MotionVerse, a large-scale, multi-source human-motion dataset unified under the SOMA representation. Across the reported comparisons, SeMoCo achieves the best reconstruction accuracy among the compared codecs, while strong text-to-motion results demonstrate the effectiveness of its motion tokens for downstream generation.
articles.titleCn: SeMoCo：一种面向运动语言模型的语义优先运动编码器
articles.abstractCn: 离散运动表示在自回归文本到运动的生成方面取得了显著进展。然而，大多数运动分词器都是针对重建进行优化的，并未根据语义角色明确分配容量。因此，动作层面的意义和细粒度的运动学细节必须通过相同的重建驱动层次进行编码。我们引入了SeMoCo，这是一种语义优先的运动编码器，以及一个用于语言条件运动生成的双轴运动生成器。每个运动分词包含一个语义分词和一个运动学分词的残差序列。生成器对时间上的语义进展进行建模，并自回归地细化残差条目。我们还构建了Ω-MotionVerse，这是一个大规模、多源的人类运动数据集，在SOMA表示下统一。在报告的比较中，SeMoCo在比较的编码器中实现了最高的重建精度，而强大的文本到运动结果则证明了其运动分词在下游生成中的有效性。

articles.title: Speech-to-SOAP: End-to-End Summarization of Medical Dialogues: KIT@BeTraC 2026
articles.abstract: With the advent of Large Language Models and its instruction following capabilities a promising application is the task of summarization. Within this domain of task the extractive sub-task of clinical protocolling has emerged as a topic of particular interest as it can significantly reduce the downtime and protocolling burden of health-care workers thus enabling them to focus on their core work helping humans. A further step towards automation is the direct generation of clinical notes from speech without intermediate transcripts, reducing processing time while preserving information such as coughing or other paralinguistic cues that may be lost in transcript-based systems. To this end, we present KIT's submission to this years BeTraC challenge in the lightweight track. Our main contribution is a scalable data augmentation pipeline that unifies heterogeneous medical dialogue datasets through synthetic speech generation and automatically generated SOAP supervision, enabling robust adaptation of a speech foundation model for end-to-end speech-to-SOAP generation.
articles.titleCn: 语音到SOAP：医疗对话端到端摘要：KIT@BeTraC 2026
articles.abstractCn: 随着大型语言模型及其指令遵循能力的出现，一项有前景的应用是摘要任务。在这一任务领域中，临床记录的抽取子任务已成为一个特别引人关注的主题，因为它可以显著减少医疗工作者的停工时间和记录负担，从而让他们能够专注于核心工作——帮助人类。迈向自动化更进一步的步骤是从语音直接生成临床记录，无需中间转录，这既能减少处理时间，又能保留可能被基于转录系统丢失的信息，例如咳嗽或其他副语言线索。为此，我们提交了KIT在这一年BeTraC挑战中轻量级赛道的参赛作品。我们的主要贡献是一个可扩展的数据增强管道，该管道通过合成语音生成和自动生成的SOAP监督，统一了异构的医疗对话数据集，从而使语音基础模型能够稳健地适应端到端的语音到SOAP生成。

articles.title: Who is the Agent to Blame? Localizing Faithfulness and Citation Mistakes in Agentic Deep Research
articles.abstract: Deep research (DR) systems produce long-form cited reports by orchestrating multiple agents that search and synthesize information from the web. Citations are the primary mechanism for evaluating the faithfulness of these reports, yet current DR systems exhibit poor citation recall. Moreover, improving citation recall is challenging because DR systems are complex multi-agent architectures where information passes through agents like a telephone game, and both content and citations can get corrupted along the way. We propose an evaluation method that pinpoints which agent introduced each error by locally testing agent invocations for faithfulness and verifiability relative to their own inputs. Furthermore, we propose a four-type taxonomy to categorize the discovered errors: hallucination, uncited input reliance, uncited output, or insufficient citations. Applying our method to three top-ranked open-source DR systems, we obtain actionable diagnostics. Almost every agent makes a lot of mistakes with the exception being those that summarize a single document. We find that the dominant error type varies systematically across agents, where the orchestrator mistakes are mostly citation-related. We find that 84.7% of final-report errors in AI-Q originate at the orchestrator, roughly 31% of them hallucinations and the rest citation mistakes. Guided by these insights, we demonstrate that two simple interventions raise citation recall by 5% without degrading output quality.
articles.titleCn: 谁是责任代理人？在代理深度研究中定位忠诚度和引用错误
articles.abstractCn: 深度研究（DR）系统通过协调多个智能体从网络中搜索和综合信息来生成长篇引用报告。引用是评估这些报告忠实性的主要机制，然而当前的DR系统表现出较差的引用召回率。此外，提高引用召回率具有挑战性，因为DR系统是复杂的智能体架构，信息在智能体之间传递如同电话游戏，内容和引用都可能在这个过程中被损坏。我们提出了一种评估方法，通过局部测试智能体调用相对于其输入的忠实性和可验证性来定位引入每个错误的智能体。此外，我们提出了一个四类型分类法来对发现的错误进行分类：幻觉、未引用输入依赖、未引用输出或引用不足。将我们的方法应用于三个排名靠前的开源DR系统，我们获得了可操作的诊断结果。除了总结单个文档的智能体外，几乎每个智能体都会犯很多错误。我们发现主导错误类型在智能体之间系统地变化，其中协调者的错误大多是引用相关的。我们发现AI-Q中最终报告的84.7%的错误源于协调者，其中大约31%是幻觉，其余是引用错误。根据这些见解，我们证明两种简单的干预措施在不降低输出质量的情况下将引用召回率提高了5%。

articles.title: SENSESHIFT: Continuous Sentiment-Controlled Text Generation via Encoder-based Mask Infilling
articles.abstract: Recent controllable text generation (CTG) for sentiment control has largely focused on decoder-based large language models, making causal attention the dominant paradigm. While effective for fluent generation, these models still struggle to satisfy complex constraints and follow fine-grained sentiment signals specified by users. Existing sentiment-aware CTG methods typically simplify the problem by treating sentiment either as a coarse categorical label (e.g., positive or negative) or as a single fine-grained control signal applied to an entire document. Consequently, more challenging settings such as sentence-level sentiment control within long-form text remain underexplored. To address these limitations, we introduce SenseShift , an encoder-based framework for fine-grained sentence-level CTG. Unlike standard decoder architectures, SenseShift leverages bidirectional attention, quantized sentiment signals, and iterative mask infilling to generate local sentences conditioned on target sentiment intensity. Empirical evaluations on story and review generation demonstrate that SenseShift achieves stronger sentiment controllability while maintaining text quality and robustness to out-of-domain generation compared to larger decoder-based baselines.
articles.titleCn: SENSESHIFT：基于编码器的掩码填充实现连续情感控制文本生成
articles.abstractCn: 近期在情感控制的可控文本生成（CTG）领域的研究，主要集中于基于解码器的大型语言模型，使得因果注意力成为主导范式。虽然这些模型在流畅生成方面效果显著，但它们仍难以满足复杂的约束条件并遵循用户指定的细粒度情感信号。现有的情感感知CTG方法通常通过将情感简化为粗略的分类标签（例如正面或负面）或作为应用于整个文档的单个细粒度控制信号来简化问题。因此，诸如长文本中的句子级情感控制等更具挑战性的场景仍待探索。为解决这些局限性，我们引入了SenseShift，这是一个基于编码器的细粒度句子级CTG框架。与标准的解码器架构不同，SenseShift利用双向注意力、量化情感信号和迭代掩码填充，根据目标情感强度生成局部句子。在故事和评论生成上的实证评估表明，与更大的基于解码器的基线模型相比，SenseShift在保持文本质量的同时，实现了更强的情感可控性，并对领域外生成具有更强的鲁棒性。

articles.title: RePolicy: Reinforcement Learning for Safety-Policy Invocation in Agent Safeguards
articles.abstract: Safeguarding language model agents requires assessing complete execution trajectories under context-dependent safety policies. Existing policy-aware safeguards mainly rely on prompting or supervised fine-tuning, limiting their ability to adapt to unseen trajectories and changing policy contexts. We propose RePolicy, an agent safeguard that learns safety-policy invocation through reinforcement learning. Given an agent trajectory and a dynamic policy library, RePolicy invokes the applicable policy and uses its content to produce a policy-grounded rationale and safety judgment. We construct PolicyTraj-20K to support supervised initialization, followed by GRPO with verifiable rewards and policy-context perturbation. Experiments across six agent safety benchmarks show that RePolicy achieves strong overall safety-detection performance and robust policy invocation under varying policy contexts.
articles.titleCn: RePolicy：用于智能体安全保护中的安全策略调用的强化学习
articles.abstractCn: 保护语言模型代理需要根据依赖上下文的安全策略评估完整的执行轨迹。现有的策略感知安全措施主要依赖于提示或监督微调，这限制了它们适应未见轨迹和变化策略环境的能力。我们提出了RePolicy，这是一种通过强化学习学习安全策略调用的代理安全措施。给定一个代理轨迹和一个动态策略库，RePolicy调用适用的策略，并使用其内容生成基于策略的推理和安全判断。我们构建了PolicyTraj-20K以支持监督初始化，随后进行具有可验证奖励和策略上下文扰动的GRPO。在六个代理安全基准上的实验表明，RePolicy实现了强大的整体安全检测性能，并在不同的策略环境下具有稳健的策略调用能力。

articles.title: ROBE: Reversed-Order-Biased-Experts for Extracting Extreme Long-tail Events from Historical Texts
articles.abstract: This paper proposes methods to extract over 50 types of events from a Dutch historical corpus spanning the 17th and 18th centuries. The methods we propose aim to tackle the impossible: extracting the long-tail of the long-tail. Historic data from before the 19th century is in itself a niche domain not covered in the pre-training of Large Language Models, and we aim to extract events only very scarcely annotated in the training data available for this domain. We propose creating expert classifiers for subgroups of the events present in the training data. We make these groupings based on similar frequency in the training data or on semantic relatedness. Experts trained on underrepresented events are assigned higher priority when predicting to avoid being dominated by frequency biases. We refer to this new way of combining classifiers, specifically tailored to protect the long-tail, as ROBE: Reversed-Order-Biased-Experts. We also propose a controlled method to create domain-specific synthetic data. Our two implementations of ROBE outperform a simple fine-tuned encoder model with a .10 increase in recall and a .16 increase in precision respectively. The best model achieves a .10 increase in f1 for a group of long-tail classes in our niche data set.
articles.titleCn: ROBE：反向顺序偏差专家，用于从历史文本中提取极端长尾事件
articles.abstractCn: 本文提出从涵盖17世纪和18世纪的荷兰历史语料库中提取超过50种事件的方法。我们提出的方法旨在应对不可能的任务：提取长尾中的长尾。19世纪之前的史实数据本身就是一个未被大型语言模型预训练覆盖的利基领域，我们旨在提取该领域中仅训练数据中极少标注的事件。我们提出为训练数据中存在的事件子组创建专家分类器。我们根据训练数据中的相似频率或语义相关性进行分组。在预测时，为在代表性不足的事件上训练的专家分配更高优先级，以避免被频率偏差主导。我们将这种专门为保护长尾而设计的分类器组合方式称为ROBE：反向顺序偏差专家。我们还提出了一种创建领域特定合成数据的控制方法。ROBE的两个实现分别比简单的微调编码器模型在召回率上提高了0.10，在精确率上提高了0.16。在最佳模型中，我们的利基数据集中的长尾类别组F1值提高了0.10。

articles.title: RecurSE: Bounded Recursive Self-Evaluation for LLM Rubric Judges
articles.abstract: LLM-as-judge is essential for evaluating open-ended text and steering post-training, yet improving the judge itself typically relies on expensive annotations, reward models, or distillation from stronger teachers. In this work, we eliminate external gold supervision from the RL training reward: the model's own evaluative capability generates learning signals for its optimization -- a closed-loop setting of bounded recursive self-improvement (RSI) termed Recursive Self-Evaluation (RecurSE). We study two central questions: when can self-improvement occur, and when must it stop? First, RecurSE pairs a trainable judge evaluating candidate responses under per-rule rubrics (Pass 1) with a synchronized policy-copy checker that audits the judge's reasoning against meta-rubrics to supply a scalar process reward (Pass 2). To enable learning, interface decoupling structurally isolates the checker's scalar score from the judge's verdict tokens, eliminating a degenerative token-copying shortcut that inflates self-assigned rewards. Second, because unanchored recursive learning is inherently bounded, Pairwise Advantage Validity (PAV) serves as an unbiased validation monitor that jointly tracks judge accuracy and checker fidelity to reliably identify the optimal early-stopping window. Across Qwen3.5-9B, Gemma-4-E4B-it, and Qwen3.6-27B, RecurSE achieves consistent generalization gains across held-out medical, pairwise, summarization, and professional benchmarks. Ablations demonstrate that synchronized judge-checker co-evolution outperforms frozen checkers, external meta-judges, self-consistency, and scaled teacher distillation. Furthermore, preference pairs curated by our judge effectively enhance downstream policy alignment. Bounded RSI for LLM-as-judge is thus viable when self-produced reward validity is explicitly decoupled and monitored.
articles.titleCn: RecurSE：面向LLM评分员的有限递归自评估
articles.abstractCn: LLM-as-judge对于评估开放式文本和指导后训练至关重要，但改进裁判本身通常依赖于昂贵的标注、奖励模型或从更强的教师那里进行蒸馏。在这项工作中，我们从RL训练奖励中消除了外部黄金监督：模型的自身评估能力为其优化生成学习信号——这是一种有界递归自改进（RSI）的闭环设置，称为递归自我评估（RecurSE）。我们研究了两个核心问题：何时可以进行自我改进，以及何时必须停止？首先，RecurSE将一个可训练的裁判与每条规则下的候选响应评估（Pass 1）配对，同时使用一个同步的策略复制检查器来审计裁判的推理，以符合元规则，并提供一个标量过程奖励（Pass 2）。为了实现学习，接口解耦在结构上隔离了检查器的标量分数与裁判的裁决标记，消除了一个导致自我分配奖励膨胀的退化标记复制捷径。其次，由于无锚点的递归学习本质上是有界的，成对优势有效性（PAV）作为一个无偏验证监控器，共同跟踪裁判的准确性和检查器的保真度，以可靠地识别最佳的提前停止窗口。在Qwen3.5-9B、Gemma-4-E4B-it和Qwen3.6-27B上，RecurSE在保留的医学、成对、摘要和专业基准上实现了一致的泛化增益。消融实验表明，同步的裁判-检查器共同进化优于冻结的检查器、外部元裁判、自一致性和缩放教师蒸馏。此外，由我们的裁判精心策划的偏好对有效地增强了下游策略对齐。因此，当自我产生的奖励有效性被明确解耦和监控时，有界RSI对于LLM-as-judge是可行的。

articles.title: Measuring Digital Labour Market Transitions with a Digital Semantic Score: An AI-Based Methodology Applied to the Dutch Labour Market
articles.abstract: The digital transformation of the Dutch labour market is reshaping occupational language, career pathways, and job-related skills. Addressing these changes requires granular labour market intelligence. This paper develops an AI-based methodology to analyse digitalisation using data covering millions of Dutch job profiles. The methodology combines embedding-based similarity search and large language model classification to map unstructured job information to harmonised ESCO occupations. We also introduce a Digital Semantic Score that measures how strongly job titles and skills are associated with digital concepts relative to a non-digital reference. Using embeddings and cosine similarity to transparent digital and non-digital anchor groups, this indicator moves beyond keyword-based approaches by capturing broader digital meanings in occupational language and worker skill profiles. It enables analysis across occupations, career transitions, emerging job-title vocabulary, and skill digitality. The findings reveal that digitalisation is unevenly distributed across the labour market. Digital job-title language is most prominent among managerial, professional and ICT-related occupations, but is increasingly visible in hybrid business, marketing and automation-related roles. Career-transition analyses show that movement toward digital work is pathway-dependent, while skill analyses highlight the multidimensional nature of digital capability, encompassing technical, hybrid and business-systems skills. By combining profile data, AI-supported occupational classification and semantic scoring, this study advances AI-driven labour market analytics and provides a scalable framework for monitoring digital labour market change. The methodology helps identify emerging skill needs, support reskilling strategies, and inform policies addressing skills mismatches and labour shortages in the Netherlands.
articles.titleCn: 使用数字语义分数衡量数字劳动力市场转型：一种应用于荷兰劳动力市场的基于人工智能的方法论
articles.abstractCn: 荷兰劳动力市场的数字化转型正在重塑职业语言、职业路径和工作相关技能。应对这些变化需要精细化的劳动力市场情报。本文开发了一种基于人工智能的方法，利用涵盖数百万荷兰工作档案的数据来分析数字化。该方法结合了基于嵌入的相似性搜索和大型语言模型分类，将非结构化的工作信息映射到协调的ESCO职业分类。我们还引入了数字语义评分，用于衡量工作标题和技能与数字概念相比非数字参考的关联强度。通过使用嵌入和余弦相似性来透明地划分数字和非数字锚定组，该指标超越了基于关键词的方法，通过捕捉职业语言和工人技能档案中的更广泛的数字含义。它能够分析不同职业、职业转型、新兴工作标题词汇和技能的数字化程度。研究结果表明，数字化在劳动力市场中的分布是不均衡的。数字工作标题语言在管理、专业和ICT相关职业中最突出，但越来越多地出现在混合商业、营销和自动化相关角色中。职业转型分析表明，向数字工作的转变取决于路径，而技能分析则突出了数字能力的多维性质，包括技术、混合和商业系统技能。通过结合档案数据、人工智能支持的职业分类和语义评分，本研究推进了人工智能驱动的劳动力市场分析，并提供了一个可扩展的框架来监测数字劳动力市场的变化。该方法有助于识别新兴技能需求，支持再培训策略，并为解决荷兰技能错配和劳动力短缺问题提供政策参考。

articles.title: DeepRepoQA: Code Repository Question Answering with Deep Agent Exploration
articles.abstract: Answering developer questions about a software repository is a critical yet under-explored problem in software engineering. While existing repository understanding methods have advanced the field, they predominantly rely on surface-level code retrieval and lack the ability for deep reasoning over multiple files, complex software architectures, and grounding answers in long-range code dependencies. To address these limitations, we propose DeepRepoQA, a novel question answering (QA) framework for repository-level code understanding. DeepRepoQA builds on an agentic framework where LLM agents find answers through a systematic tree search over the repository structure. A Monte-Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) mechanism is employed to empower agents to dynamically search, navigate, and inspect code, enabling effective multi-hop reasoning over long-range code dependencies. Comprehensive experiments on the SWE-QA benchmark demonstrate substantial performance gains over strong baselines, validating the effectiveness of systematic MCTS-guided exploration for multi-hop repository reasoning.
articles.titleCn: DeepRepoQA：深度智能体探索代码仓库问答系统
articles.abstractCn: 回答关于软件仓库的开发者问题是一个在软件工程中至关重要但尚未得到充分探索的问题。尽管现有的仓库理解方法推动了该领域的发展，但它们主要依赖于表面层次的代码检索，缺乏对多个文件、复杂软件架构以及基于长距离代码依赖进行深度推理的能力。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了DeepRepoQA，这是一个用于仓库级代码理解的新型问答（QA）框架。DeepRepoQA基于一个智能体框架，其中大型语言模型（LLM）智能体通过系统性地搜索仓库结构来寻找答案。采用蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）机制来赋予智能体动态搜索、导航和检查代码的能力，从而实现有效的多跳推理，跨越长距离代码依赖。在SWE-QA基准测试上的全面实验表明，与强基线相比，性能有显著提升，验证了系统性的MCTS引导探索对于多跳仓库推理的有效性。

articles.title: Constraint-Guided Enterprise Data Mapping with Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Enterprise entity alignment must handle semi-structured records, implicit attributes, and unit or granularity mismatches. Manual matching is still common in practice, but does not scale as schemas and providers evolve. LLM-only matching improves semantic recall, yet can violate structural and physical invariants, producing fluent yet operationally invalid correspondences. We propose constraint-guided mapping (CGM), a neuro-symbolic method with three stages: (i) schema-grounded admissibility constraints with metadata mc = <tau_c, delta_c>, where tau_c denotes the constraint type and delta_c provides executable relation and normalization logic; (ii) constraint-restricted candidate generation with cascade relaxation to guarantee a nonempty feasible set under noise; and (iii) neural ranking with bounded LLM disambiguation restricted to that feasible set. Methodologically, constraints operate as hypothesis-space operators rather than post-hoc validators, enabling controlled degradation under relaxation and auditable, human-guidable decisions. On a controlled structural-decoy benchmark, hard admissibility shrinks the candidate space by ~480x without dropping the GT, and a layer-by-layer ablation shows this gate, not the LLM, is the decisive lift (F1 0.08 to 0.66). The benefit is model-independent and adds no extra inference cost: a small model with constraints matches a frontier LLM used without them at ~28x lower cost. The method, not a single tuned configuration, transfers across seven enterprise makes (macro F1 0.70), each under its own automatically discovered, expert-refinable constraints, and lowers expert effort by ~7x versus spreadsheet workflows. Public Valentine results add an external ranking sanity check and mark the boundary: constraints should be hard only where structural invariants are match-determining.

articles.titleCn: 基于约束的企业数据映射方法与大型语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 企业实体对齐必须处理半结构化记录、隐式属性以及单元或粒度不匹配问题。实践中手动匹配仍然普遍，但随着模式（schema）和提供者的演变，其扩展性不足。仅使用大型语言模型（LLM）的匹配可以提高语义召回率，但可能违反结构和物理不变性，产生流畅但操作上无效的对应关系。我们提出约束引导映射（CGM），这是一种神经符号方法，包含三个阶段：（i）基于模式的可接受性约束，其元数据mc = <tau_c, delta_c>，其中tau_c表示约束类型，delta_c提供可执行的关联和归一化逻辑；（ii）约束限制的候选生成，通过级联松弛保证在噪声下存在非空的可行集；（iii）神经排序，使用受限于该可行集的有界LLM消歧。在方法论上，约束作为假设空间算子而非事后验证器运行，从而在松弛下实现可控退化，并支持可审计、可人工指导的决策。在一个受控的结构性诱饵基准测试中，硬性可接受性将候选空间缩小约480倍，且不丢失基准目标（GT），逐层消融实验表明，是此门控而非LLM决定了性能提升（F1从0.08提升到0.66）。该优势与模型无关，且不增加额外推理成本：一个带约束的小模型匹配一个未使用约束的边界LLM，成本降低约28倍。该方法，而非单一调优配置，可跨七个企业品牌（宏观F1 0.70）迁移，每个品牌都有其自动发现、专家可精炼的约束，并使专家工作量降低约7倍，相较于电子表格工作流程。公开情人节测试结果增加了外部排序合理性检查，并划定了边界：约束仅在结构性不变性决定匹配时才应设为硬性约束。

articles.title: Preference Data Selection for Mitigating the Alignment Tax in Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Aligning large language models to human preferences is crucial for real-world deployment but frequently incurs an alignment tax, leading to the catastrophic forgetting of pre-trained general capabilities. While previous works primarily frame this problem as an optimization or architectural challenge, the inherent characteristics of preference data that drive this degradation remain largely underexplored. In this paper, we propose BALIGN, a balanced data selection strategy that explicitly mitigates catastrophic forgetting while optimizing alignment efficacy. Through theoretical and empirical analyses of the preference optimization gradient, we identify three key data-centric features that dictate parameter drift: the reference model's log-probability margin, the token length difference between chosen and rejected responses, and the TF-IDF similarity to general capability corpora. By aggregating these orthogonal features into a unified composite risk score, BALIGN systematically filters out high-risk preference samples that disrupt intrinsic model parameters or provide minimal alignment utility. Extensive experiments on standard human preference datasets demonstrate that BALIGN strongly preserves foundational capabilities without compromising alignment gains, consistently achieving the optimal Pareto frontier with minimal computational overhead.
articles.titleCn: 缓解大型语言模型对齐税的偏好数据选择
articles.abstractCn: 将大型语言模型与人类偏好对齐对于实际部署至关重要，但经常导致对齐成本，进而引发预训练通用能力的灾难性遗忘。尽管以往研究主要将此问题视为优化或架构挑战，但驱动这种退化的偏好数据的内在特征仍被广泛忽视。在本文中，我们提出了BALIGN，一种平衡数据选择策略，在优化对齐效能的同时，明确缓解灾难性遗忘。通过对偏好优化梯度的理论及实证分析，我们识别出三个决定参数漂移的数据中心特征：参考模型的概率边际、选定与拒绝响应之间的标记长度差异，以及与通用能力语料库的TF-IDF相似度。通过将这些正交特征聚合为统一的风险评分，BALIGN系统性地过滤掉那些破坏内在模型参数或提供最小对齐效用的高风险偏好样本。在标准人类偏好数据集上的大量实验表明，BALIGN在保留基础能力的同时显著提升对齐收益，始终以最小的计算开销达到最优的帕累托前沿。

articles.title: 'Ghaib in Translation' aka Unseen Harm: Measuring Cross-Script Safety Inconsistency with 'Missed-in-Urdu' Scores in LLM Hate Speech Detection
articles.abstract: Urdu, the world's tenth most spoken language with 246 million speakers, remains almost entirely absent from mainstream LLM safety evaluation and nine years of WOAH proceedings. To investigate whether this absence has measurable consequences for content moderation reliability, five large language models, GPT-4o, Claude Sonnet 4.5, Gemini 2.5 Flash, Qwen-2.5, and Llama-3.1, were tested across six datasets spanning Nastaliq Urdu, Roman Urdu, English, and code-switched Urdu-English. Across the five Urdu-script datasets, label instability between original-script and English-translation classification ranged from 15.9% (Gemini 2.5 Flash) to 31.6% (Qwen-2.5), with a 'Missed-in-Urdu' rate, content flagged as harmful in English translation but passed as normal in the original script, ranging from 2.4% to 9.9% (median 4.3%). A complete enumeration of all 205 papers across nine ALW/WOAH editions via the ACL Anthology API confirms zero dedicated Urdu papers across the entire period. Results indicate that current LLMs provide uneven safety assurance across Urdu's script varieties, with smaller open-weight models showing substantially higher instability and missed-harm rates than frontier closed models.
articles.titleCn: 《Ghaib的翻译》又名《未见之害》：使用“乌尔都语中遗漏”分数在大型语言模型仇恨言论检测中衡量跨文本安全不一致性
articles.abstractCn: 乌尔都语是世界上最使用人数第十的语言，拥有2.46亿使用者，但在主流大型语言模型安全评估和九年来的WOAH（世界动物卫生组织）程序中几乎完全缺席。为调查这种缺席是否对内容审核可靠性有可衡量的后果，对五种大型语言模型——GPT-4o、Claude Sonnet 4.5、Gemini 2.5 Flash、Qwen-2.5和Llama-3.1——在涵盖纳斯塔利克乌尔都语、罗马乌尔都语、英语和乌尔都-英语代码转换的六个数据集上进行了测试。在五种乌尔都文字数据集中，原始文字与英语翻译分类之间的标签不稳定率在15.9%（Gemini 2.5 Flash）到31.6%（Qwen-2.5）之间，而“乌尔都语中遗漏有害内容”率（英语翻译中被标记为有害但在原始文字中被判定为正常）在2.4%到9.9%之间（中位数4.3%）。通过ACL文摘API对九期ALW/WOAH的所有205篇论文进行全面枚举，证实整个时期内完全没有专门的乌尔都语论文。结果表明，当前的大型语言模型在乌尔都语的不同文字变体上提供不均衡的安全保障，较小的开放权重模型显示出比前沿封闭模型显著更高的不稳定率和遗漏有害内容率。

articles.title: MemUse: Moving Memory Evaluation from Direct QA to Natural Integration in Long-Term Human-AI Conversation
articles.abstract: Memory systems for conversational LLMs are conventionally evaluated by direct, fact-seeking questions about prior dialogue (Direct QA): can the model recall fact X from a prior conversation? We tested whether higher Direct QA accuracy correlates with higher user satisfaction in a 4-month deployment (40 users, 1,872 sessions, 7 memory conditions). Existing-benchmark Direct QA varies from 19.7% to 70.1% across the 7 conditions, but satisfaction does not change. We hypothesize that existing benchmarks and user satisfaction are tracking different capabilities: benchmarks measure elicited retrieval (recall when asked), while conversation requires natural integration (detecting relevance and naturally weaving prior context into a response). To examine this, we introduce MemUse, a set of real user-cued memory moments drawn from the deployment, scored by an integration-aware judgment of the natural conversational response. Holding the model and context fixed, the same system that scores 78.8% on Direct QA references only 7.9% of those facts in conversation -- a 71-point gap. Within these moments, Natural Integration is associated with satisfaction, whereas Direct QA is not. We release the deployment corpus and MemUse together with all judgments and scoring prompts at https://github.com/ryuichi-sumida/memuse.

articles.titleCn: MemUse：将内存评估从直接问答迁移到长期人机对话中的自然整合
articles.abstractCn: 对话式大语言模型的记忆系统传统上通过直接、寻求事实的问题（直接问答）来评估，即模型能否从之前的对话中回忆起事实X？我们在为期4个月的部署中（40名用户，1,872次会话，7种记忆条件）测试了直接问答准确率是否与用户满意度相关。现有基准的直接问答准确率在7种条件下从19.7%到70.1%不等，但满意度并未变化。我们假设现有基准与用户满意度追踪的是不同能力：基准测量的是被提示的检索（在被问及时的记忆召回），而对话需要自然的整合（检测相关性并将先前上下文自然地融入回答中）。为验证这一点，我们引入了MemUse，这是一组从部署中提取的真实用户提示的记忆时刻，由对自然对话回答的整合感知判断进行评分。在固定模型和上下文的情况下，同一个在直接问答中得分为78.8%的系统在对话中仅引用了7.9%的相关事实——存在71分的差距。在这些时刻中，自然整合与满意度相关，而直接问答则不然。我们与部署语料库和MemUse一起发布了所有判断和评分提示，可在https://github.com/ryuichi-sumida/memuse获取。

articles.title: Paritok-4B: Intent-Conditioned Context Compression for Coding Agents
articles.abstract: Coding agents re-send large file reads and tool outputs to a frontier LLM every turn, and this context dominates their token bill. General-purpose prompt compressors are trained on prose and suit code poorly: they paraphrase identifiers and drop the exact spans an agent needs to edit. We present Paritok-4B, a 4B LoRA compressor for coding-agent trajectories built on two commitments. It is extractive: it selects spans rather than rewriting them, and 96.0% of the identifiers, paths, and numbers it emits already appear in its input, holding at 96.2% on held-out SWE-bench Lite output. It is intent-conditioned: told the agent's current task, it acts chiefly inside a retained segment, selecting which lines survive (retained lines are +0.067 more intent-relevant than removed ones, paired 95% CI [+0.056, +0.078]) rather than changing how much is retained. We distil a gpt-4.1-mini teacher over 67,074 real OpenHands trajectories into 40,606 validated examples and fine-tune Qwen3-4B. On all 300 SWE-bench Lite instances, Paritok-4B compresses agent context to 25.7% of its size, 2.0x harder than a gpt-4.1-mini compressor (50.2%) and 2.4x harder than gpt-5 (61.9%), while retaining 86.5% of uncompressed single-shot solve quality. Fed the cat -n line-numbered input real agents produce, it compresses slightly less (27.8%) and retains more (89.3%); there the paired test is informative, with 30 instances solved only uncompressed and 17 only compressed, an exact McNemar p=0.079, so at this sample size compressing context to roughly a quarter of its size does not significantly reduce the solve rate. The model is a 264 MB adapter that self-hosts on one 24 GB GPU with no per-token compressor fee, which at list prices decides the economics: gpt-5 as a compressor is net-negative, costing more than the downstream tokens it saves. Weights, data, and evaluation scripts are open (Apache 2.0).
articles.titleCn: Paritok-4B：为编码代理的意图条件上下文压缩
articles.abstractCn: 编码代理每轮将大文件读取和工具输出重新发送给前沿大语言模型，这种上下文主导了它们的token费用。通用提示压缩器基于散文进行训练，不适合代码：它们会改写标识符并丢弃代理需要编辑的精确范围。我们提出了Paritok-4B，一个基于两个承诺构建的4B LoRA编码代理轨迹压缩器。它是提取式的：它选择范围而不是重写它们，它发出的96.0%的标识符、路径和数字已经出现在输入中，在保留的SWE-bench Lite输出上保持在96.2%。它是意图条件的：在得知代理当前任务后，它主要在保留的范围内操作，选择哪些行存活（保留的行比删除的行意图相关度高出+0.067，配对95% CI [+0.056, +0.078]）。我们将gpt-4.1-mini教师从67,074个真实的OpenHands轨迹中蒸馏成40,606个验证示例，并微调Qwen3-4B。在所有300个SWE-bench Lite实例中，Paritok-4B将代理上下文压缩到其大小的25.7%，比gpt-4.1-mini压缩器（50.2%）难2.0倍，比gpt-5（61.9%）难2.4倍，同时保留了86.5%的未压缩单次解决质量。输入真实代理生成的带行号输入的"cat -n"，它压缩稍少（27.8%），但保留更多（89.3%）；在那里配对测试是有意义的，有30个实例仅未压缩解决，17个仅压缩解决，精确的McNemar p=0.079，所以在这个样本量下将上下文压缩到大约四分之一大小并不会显著降低解决率。该模型是一个264 MB的适配器，可以在一个24 GB的GPU上自托管，没有每个token的压缩器费用，这在标价上决定了经济性：作为压缩器的gpt-5是净负的，其成本超过了它节省的下游token。权重、数据和评估脚本都是开放的（Apache 2.0）。

articles.title: FireRedAudio: A General-Purpose Audio Language Model with Decoupled Continuous Representations for Understanding and Generation
articles.abstract: A unified audio model must recognize and understand linguistic, paralinguistic, and environmental information while supporting speech synthesis and editing. A key challenge is representation: understanding favors compact features suited to long-context modeling, whereas speech generation requires reconstructible features that preserve fine-grained acoustic detail. We introduce FireRedAudio, a general-purpose audio language model with a shared 9B-parameter LLM. To the best of our knowledge, it is the first publicly disclosed unified audio-language model to provide separate continuous input representations for understanding and generation within a single trainable autoregressive LLM. Audio to be recognized or analyzed is processed by a dedicated Audio Encoder, while speech inputs for generation use a RedAE-based pathway. The LLM directly generates text or conditions a flow-matching DiT to produce continuous acoustic latents. Through progressive multitask training, FireRedAudio supports ASR and audio understanding, with the latter extending to recordings of up to one hour, as well as zero-shot TTS, Instruct TTS, and semantic and acoustic speech editing. Its structured organization of long-form audio achieves second-level timestamp accuracy. Across comprehensive evaluations, FireRedAudio achieves competitive or leading performance in audio understanding and multilingual ASR, strong content accuracy and speaker preservation in zero-shot TTS, leading instruction following in Instruct TTS, and substantial improvements over Ming-UniAudio-Edit in both semantic and acoustic speech editing. These results demonstrate the viability of decoupled continuous input representations for unifying audio understanding and continuous-latent speech generation in a model of moderate scale. Our code is available at https://github.com/FireRedTeam/FireRedAudio.
